title: Mofongo
description: Mofongo is a dish from Puerto Rico featuring plantain, garlic, pork cracklings, cilantro. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 16 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 12 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Combine these ingredients in a pot, bring just to a boil and skim any foam. Simmer gently for about 8 minutes to make a flavorful base.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
